bio.text: Thomas Holbrook is the Libertarian candidate for Missouri's 4th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election.
He is a federal government contractor and the secretary of the Missouri Libertarian Party, and he previously ran for Congress in 2012 and 2024.
According to his campaign website, he was born in 1983 at Williams Air Force Base in Arizona and moved to Missouri about a year later, where he grew up near Leeton.
